headline: Historic record in agricultural exports! Reached $27.1 billion in nine months
summary: Turkish agricultural product exports rose 4.4% to $27.1 billion in January–September, breaking the all-time record for that period, on strong global demand.
why: Agricultural exports are a significant source of foreign currency for Turkey and affect its trade balance. Strong export performance can influence the lira and the current account.
